# Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake)
Source: https://llms-explorer.com/tree/cross-vendor-focus-pipelines-bigquery-snowflake/

# Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake) — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake). Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-31 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## How it works

- [statement] Atlas supplies FOCUS 1.3 CSV reports through its console and asynchronous report-generation API; the API returns a report ID for status polling and a download URL when ready. A warehouse pipeline must orchestrate this extraction and load. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md
- [statement] Google FOCUS export backfill depends on location: US/EU multi-regions include the previous month and initial export can take five days; single regions start at enablement. Periods when export was disabled may remain missing. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26) — https://docs.cloud.google.com/billing/docs/how-to/export-data-bigquery-tables/focus-export

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Atlas FOCUS reports cover usage costs but exclude commitment shortfalls, taxes, adjustments and refunds; a pipeline cannot use this export alone to reproduce the full invoice. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] FOCUS provides common billing vocabulary across providers, allowing Atlas costs and Google Cloud billing exports to feed a shared analytical model; this is interoperability of billing datasets rather than replication of application collections. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md · keywords: Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake) · also: https://docs.cloud.google.com/billing/docs/how-to/export-data-bigquery-tables/focus-export
- [statement] A practitioner thread on consolidating AWS and GCP exports reports version mismatch and recommends a thin provider mapping layer with unknown fields left null rather than guessed. This is anecdotal implementation evidence, not authoritative current provider-version documentation. (low confidence) — https://www.reddit.com/r/FinOps/comments/1sfwaso/consolidating_awsgcp_billing_data_into_focus/
- [statement] Snowflake refreshes hourly but permits 72-hour usage latency and changes until month close. Inference: refresh open billing periods rather than treating a daily extract as final. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/billing/focus_cost_usage_v1_3

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Atlas documents FOCUS 1.3 CSV reports, generated asynchronously through request-and-poll API endpoints. A warehouse loader must download the resulting artifact; the cited documentation does not describe a managed BigQuery or Snowflake billing sink. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md
- [statement] Google Cloud's documented native FOCUS export is Preview and creates an immutable BigQuery dataset and billing table. Google recommends normalization views to protect consumer queries from schema changes. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26) — https://docs.cloud.google.com/billing/docs/how-to/export-data-bigquery-tables/focus-export
- [statement] Snowflake documents an open-preview SNOWFLAKE.BILLING.FOCUS_COST_USAGE_V1_3 view with daily charges. Access requires an org-enabled account and the SNOWFLAKE.ORGANIZATION_BILLING_VIEWER database role. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/billing/focus_cost_usage_v1_3
- [statement] Native FOCUS datasets still have conformance gaps: Google lists missing commitment-discount fields and InvoiceId; Snowflake lists unpopulated CommitmentDiscount*, Sku*, PricingCurrency* and resource fields. Do not assume every standardized column is usable. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/billing/focus_cost_usage_v1_3 · keywords: Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake) · also: https://docs.cloud.google.com/billing/docs/how-to/export-data-bigquery-tables/focus-export
- [statement] Current-month totals need later reconciliation: Atlas directs consumers to re-pull after invoice closure; Snowflake says daily data can change until month close and usage may arrive up to 72 hours late. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md · keywords: Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake) · also: https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/billing/focus_cost_usage_v1_3
- [statement] Recommended pipeline design, inferred from the documented interfaces and engineering guidance: preserve raw exports privately, map into a chosen warehouse schema, reconcile commitments and currencies, then publish normalized analytical tables. Retaining raw inputs supports reprocessing after mapping fixes. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md · keywords: Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake) · also: https://multicloudoptimization.com/blog/focus-data-pipelines-in-practice/
- [statement] Vantage's June 10, 2025 launch described conversion of selected CSV/PDF invoices into FOCUS 1.1 CSV and explicitly lacked an automation API. Its converter can illustrate mappings, but that dated announcement does not establish a current production ingestion service. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2025-06-10) — https://focus.vantage.sh/ · keywords: Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake) · also: https://www.vantage.sh/blog/vantage-launches-focus-vantage-sh
- [statement] Preserve billing-currency cost and pricing-unit semantics separately. Atlas distinguishes billing currency from Atlas Credit pricing currency; Snowflake distinguishes consumed from pricing quantities, including storage measured in TiB-Days but priced in TiB-Months. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md · keywords: Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake) · also: https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/billing/focus_cost_usage_v1_3
- [statement] FOCUS issue #2315 documents split-allocation implementation pitfalls: translating provider allocation fields can require splitting rows, and queries must include allocated and unallocated portions without double counting. This is an implementation concern, not evidence of a warehouse-specific incident. (low confidence) — https://github.com/FinOps-Open-Cost-and-Usage-Spec/FOCUS_Spec/issues/2315
- [statement] FOCUS provides a common cost-and-usage vocabulary across Atlas reports, Google Cloud BigQuery exports, and Snowflake billing views; a warehouse consolidation pipeline still needs adapters for the different delivery mechanisms. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.cloud.google.com/billing/docs/how-to/export-data-bigquery-tables/focus-export · keywords: Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake) · also: https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/billing/focus_cost_usage_v1_3, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md
- [statement] Google Cloud provides a Preview native FOCUS export in an immutable BigQuery dataset named gcp_billing_immutable_<BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID>_<Location>, containing gcp_billing_export_focus_<BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID>. This is a Google Cloud billing source, not automatic ingestion of other vendors. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26) — https://docs.cloud.google.com/billing/docs/how-to/export-data-bigquery-tables/focus-export
- [statement] Inference for pipeline design: maintain explicit typed staging views and a curated shared-column projection before combining vendors. Google recommends normalization views to insulate queries from export schema changes; Snowflake and Google document different types and populated columns. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26) — https://docs.cloud.google.com/billing/docs/how-to/export-data-bigquery-tables/focus-export · keywords: Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake) · also: https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/billing/focus_cost_usage_v1_3
- [statement] Native FOCUS does not guarantee complete analytical dimensions. Google omits standard commitment-discount fields and Tags, retaining related information in x_Credits and provider-specific tag fields; Snowflake leaves CommitmentDiscount*, Sku*, PricingCurrency* and resource columns unpopulated. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26) — https://docs.cloud.google.com/billing/docs/how-to/export-data-bigquery-tables/focus-export · keywords: Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake) · also: https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/billing/focus_cost_usage_v1_3
- [statement] A consolidated pipeline must preserve BillingCurrency or apply an explicit reporting-currency policy before summing money. Google maps BillingCurrency to its currency field and supplies x_CurrencyConversionRate; Snowflake documents USD, while Atlas distinguishes billing currency from Atlas Credit pricing currency. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.cloud.google.com/billing/docs/how-to/export-data-bigquery-tables/focus-export · keywords: Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake) · also: https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/billing/focus_cost_usage_v1_3, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md
- [statement] Snowflake InvoiceId can be empty for capacity customers and appears only after month end for on-demand customers. Do not require it as a universal non-null pipeline key. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/billing/focus_cost_usage_v1_3
- [statement] Do not substitute usage quantity for pricing quantity or recompute every cost as the same product: Snowflake distinguishes storage TiB-Days from TiB-Months and rounded billed cost; Atlas defines separate consumed, pricing, contracted and effective-cost fields. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/billing/focus_cost_usage_v1_3 · keywords: Cross-vendor FOCUS pipelines (BigQuery/Snowflake) · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md
